q.en: Why do examiners penalise memorised, scripted Speaking answers?
q.bn: Examiner-রা কেন memorised, scripted Speaking answer penalise করে?

options.en: It's against the rules to prepare at all
Recited speech sounds unnatural and is scored down under Fluency and Coherence
options.bn: Recited speech unnatural শোনায় এবং Fluency and Coherence-এ কম score হয়

options.en: It is only penalised in Part 1
It automatically gives a band 0

why.en: Memorised speech sounds flatter and doesn't match the actual question as naturally, which examiners are trained to notice and score down.
why.bn: Memorised speech flatter শোনায় এবং actual question-এর সাথে naturally match করে না, যা examiner-রা notice করতে এবং কম score করতে trained।

q.en: What does this chapter recommend preparing instead of full memorised sentences?
q.bn: এই chapter পূর্ণ memorised sentence-এর বদলে কী prepare করতে recommend করে?

options.en: Nothing — preparation of any kind is discouraged
options.bn: কিছুই না — যে কোনো ধরনের preparation নিরুৎসাহিত করা হয়

options.en: Keyword ideas, relevant vocabulary, and a flexible structure
options.bn: Keyword idea, relevant vocabulary, এবং একটা flexible structure

options.en: A single all-purpose answer for every possible question
options.bn: প্রতিটা সম্ভাব্য question-এর জন্য একটা single all-purpose answer

options.en: Only grammar rules, no content at all
options.bn: শুধু grammar rule, কোনো content না

why.en: Preparing flexible keyword ideas and vocabulary lets you build a fresh, natural answer each time instead of reciting a fixed script.
why.bn: Flexible keyword idea এবং vocabulary prepare করলে প্রতিবার একটা fixed script recite না করে fresh, natural answer তৈরি করা যায়।

q.en: Which of these is one of the five common topic categories listed in this chapter?
q.bn: এই chapter-এ listed পাঁচটা common topic category-র একটা কোনটা?

options.en: Grammar rules
Places
Listening scripts
Quiz formats

why.en: The five categories are People, Places, Things, Events, and Activities — most real cue cards fall into one of these.
why.bn: পাঁচটা category হলো People, Places, Things, Events, এবং Activities — বেশিরভাগ real cue card এগুলোর একটায় পড়ে।

q.en: Why does practising the same real memory with a slightly different question help, according to this chapter?
q.bn: এই chapter অনুযায়ী, একই real memory নিয়ে একটু ভিন্ন question-এ practice করা কেন সাহায্য করে?

options.en: It helps you memorise the exact wording perfectly
options.bn: এটা exact wording perfectly memorise করতে সাহায্য করে

options.en: It builds genuine, flexible fluency with real content instead of a rigid script
options.bn: এটা rigid script-এর বদলে real content নিয়ে genuine, flexible fluency তৈরি করে

options.en: It guarantees the exact same question on test day
options.bn: এটা test day-তে ঠিক একই question guarantee করে

options.en: It is only useful for Part 3

why.en: Rephrasing the same real memory for different but related questions builds adaptable fluency rather than a script that breaks when the exact wording differs.
why.bn: একই real memory ভিন্ন কিন্তু related question-এ rephrase করলে adaptable fluency তৈরি হয়, একটা script না যা exact wording ভিন্ন হলে ভেঙে যায়।

q.en: What is one sign examiners notice that suggests an answer is memorised?
q.bn: একটা answer memorised কিনা তা বোঝার জন্য examiner-রা কোন একটা sign notice করে?

options.en: Speaking too quietly
A sudden jump to vocabulary far more advanced than the rest of the speech
options.bn: Speech-এর বাকি অংশের চেয়ে অনেক বেশি advanced vocabulary-তে sudden jump

options.en: Using the correct tense consistently
Answering in under 10 seconds

why.en: A sudden mismatch in vocabulary level, along with unnatural rhythm and a poor fit to the actual question, is a classic sign of a recited, memorised answer.
why.bn: Vocabulary level-এ একটা sudden mismatch, unnatural rhythm, এবং actual question-এর সাথে খারাপ fit, recited, memorised answer-এর একটা classic sign।
